text:
Sam (People Ops): Tiny hybrid-ready manager checklist + 30/60/90 + day7/14 mini-retro. One-pager to paste into calendar invites.

Mei (Eng Manager): Love a compact version. Can we add a quick note about desk/parking/badge for on-site folks?

Sam (People Ops): Yup 1: add facilities steps and who owns them. Also included WFH stipend note.

Carlos (Buddy): Add pairing slots for first two weeks (30m) so new hire has predictable window to ask dumb questions.

Sam (People Ops): Done. Short single-page below.

Sam (People Ops): ```
MANAGER HYBRID LAUNCH (week before) ~20m
- Send welcome note with start logistics, buddy, hybrid schedule preference, and ask about accommodations
- Open access tickets: Okta, Slack, GitHub, Drive, cloud role; order laptop and reserve desk/parking if onsite
- Draft 3x90 outcomes and attach to day1 1:1
- Book buddy pairing slots for weeks 1-2 (30m x 4)

DAY 1 (limit meetings to 3)
09:30-10:15 Manager 1:1: role + 90d outcomes, hybrid expectations (onsite cadence), psychological safety line
11:00-11:30 Team intro: quick intros + map where to find async help (record)
14:00-14:30 Buddy session: env + run-first-app + show pairing slots
16:30 Manager pulse: confirm access, desk/badge/parking, WFH stipend receipt, and next steps

DAYS 2-7
- 10:00 15min daily sync (live or async) to surface blockers
- Buddy pairing slots (30m) twice/week for two weeks
- Schedule security/compliance brief by day3 if needed

DAY 7 MANAGER CHECK (3)
- Confirm first PR opened/merged or task started
- Buddy confirms env, tests pass, pairing cadence set
- Manager delivered 30-day feedback + agreed next small ownership

DAY 14 MINI-RETRO (15m)
- Quick retro: what went well, top 2 blockers, any outstanding access or accommodation asks
- Assign owners + deadlines for remaining items

ACCESS & FACILITIES ESCALATION
- Okta/Slack: @it-support (DM) -> cc People Ops if >24h
- GitHub/org invites: @dev-platform -> escalate to @it-support
- Cloud roles: @infra-ops (DM)
- Badge/parking/desk: @facilities (email or DM) - if not ready by day0, cc People Ops

REMOTE/ONSITE NOTES
- Remote white-glove: 60min IT screenshare to image laptop + VPN setup (book via @it-support)
- Onsite: confirm desk and parking by day0; badge pickup window in invite
- WFH stipend: People Ops processes stipend within first payroll cycle; confirm receipt with Sam

30/60/90 (quick learning + ownership)
- 30d: orient & contribute - KPI: first PR + 2 cross-team intros
- 60d: own a small feature; fix a CI/test flake; incident readout practice
- 90d: lead a measurable improvement (perf/cost/quality) and present plan

TEMPLATES (copyable)
Manager welcome: "Hi {name}, welcome to Team X. Buddy: {buddy}. Day1 09:30-10:15 manager 1:1. We'll cover hybrid cadence, 3x90 outcomes, and pairing slots. If onsite, your badge & desk are reserved. Reply with any accessibility needs"

Slack intro: "Welcome {name} to Team X as {role}! Buddy: {buddy}. Hybrid cadence: {days onsite}. Fun fact: {one-liner} :tada:"

WHO OWNS WHAT (one line)
- Manager: outcomes, hybrid cadence, 30/60/90 alignment, psychological safety
- Buddy: pairing slots, env help, first PR pairing
- People Ops: laptop/order, stipend, badge & facilities escalation
```

Priya: Great concise doc. Please add a PDF to the onboarding repo and drop link here when ready.

OnboardBot: Laptop provisioning: order created (ETA 3 business days).

Mei (Eng Manager): Using this for my hybrid hire next week 1: thanks!
